context: Tests whether the agent installs the Tokenizer feature with a runBudget AND picks the CompressHistory budget-exceeded action (matching the developer's stated 'try to continue by summarizing' preference) rather than the default Abort which the developer explicitly rejected.

checklist.name: Installs the Tokenizer feature
checklist.description: Calls install(Tokenizer) { ... } inside the AIAgent(...) trailing lambda. Does not roll a custom token-counting wrapper or check usage in tool bodies

checklist.name: Sets a 50000 runBudget
checklist.description: Configures runBudget = 50_000 (or equivalent integer literal) inside the install block — matches the developer's stated cap

checklist.name: Picks BudgetAction.CompressHistory
checklist.description: Sets onBudgetExceeded = BudgetAction.CompressHistory. Does NOT use BudgetAction.Abort (developer explicitly rejected this) and does NOT use DowngradeModel (the developer asked for summarization, not model swap)

checklist.name: Adds the tokenizer dependencies
checklist.description: Adds both ai.koog:agents-features-tokenizer and ai.koog:prompt-tokenizer at the selected Koog 1.3 stable/beta version. Without prompt-tokenizer, the feature has no per-model tokenizer to use

checklist.name: Does not lower the model to a cheaper one
checklist.description: Does not change llmModel away from GPT4o — the developer didn't ask to swap models, only to cap spend on the current one

checklist.name: Notes how the cap surfaces in observability if installed
checklist.description: Mentions that if OpenTelemetry is also installed, token usage surfaces in the gen_ai.client.token.usage metric automatically. Not strictly required but helps the developer verify the cap
